name: Jagged Knife Bandit
description: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang’s iconic knives.

abilities.name: Climber
abilities.description: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

abilities.name: From Above
abilities.description: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 1d10+1 physical damage instead of their standard damage.
